snapshot.title: Create scene showing available rockets
snapshot.description:
Also need to make sure that we save unlocked rockets - we'll say that when users start the game, we *unlock* the first rocket then (so technically all rockets/vehicles are *locked* at some point). Just to test things out with regards to research state [management].

Should have an extra field for 'new mission' target where if this 'available-rockets' scene is launched from the new mission scene, we show the target; and we also show if the rocket can reach the target (distance limits are something for another day, though)
